name: portfolio
title: Portfolio
description: A photo-first personal site for someone who makes things. A statement and one large photograph on the front page, a grid of work led by each project's picture, project pages with a full-width image, a facts strip, prose and a gallery, then about and contact. No plugins.

demo.tagline: Books bound by hand in a harbour town

features: Work grid built from pages/work/*.md frontmatter, newest project shown large
Responsive photographs with srcset from files you drop in static/images
Project pages with a full-width image, a facts strip and a gallery
Next-project link at the foot of every project
System light and dark with a toggle

sampleContent.purpose: The statement, the hero photograph and the work grid
Six sample projects; one file each
Sample photographs at three widths; replace with your own

notes: A project names its photograph with image: and imageAlt:; without one it shows a plain tile in its cloth: colour
Projects sort by year, newest first, then by weight
